description.en: The ID of the client public key for the application.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of a request. You must generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

title.zh: 设置指定的应用ClientPublicKey优先使用

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-primary-client-public-key --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --client-public-key-id KEYEqDnDJhztiEAwSin7MZoxGcihzCAuxxxx --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetPrimaryClientPublicKey --region cn-hangzhou --ClientPublicKeyId KEYEqDnDJhztiEAwSin7MZoxGcihzCAuxxxx --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --ClientToken 'client-token-example'
